definition: Nagamatsu metrics.py dtw_and_ldtw (tslearn dtw_path: sqrt of summed squared distances along the optimal path), pixel units of the evaluation canvas
Nagamatsu metrics.py: DTW / alignment-path length (PEN-Net, Chen et al. ACCV 2022)
Nagamatsu metrics.py adaptive_iou: GT drawn at 2 px, prediction at 1 px, best IoU over 0-4 3x3 dilations; strokes with <2 points are not drawn
LPIPS (Zhang et al. 2018, AlexNet, lpips v0.1) between uniform-width renderings (2 px, anti-aliased, black on white) of GT and prediction on the evaluation canvas
symmetric mean Chamfer distance 0.5*(mean_a min_b d + mean_b min_a d) between point sets, px
symmetric Hausdorff distance between point sets, px
discrete Frechet distance (Eiter & Mannila 1994) between the concatenated point sequences in drawing order (pen-ups ignored), px
point-wise RMSE after resampling each whole ink to K points uniformly in pen-down arc length (K=320 ligature, K=2048 line), px
F1 of pen-up locations: last point of every stroke; one-to-one Hungarian matching on Euclidean distance with tolerance tau (3 px)
|n_pred - n_gt| strokes
n_pred - n_gt (signed)
fraction of GT strokes matched one-to-one (Hungarian on stroke-mask IoU, masks 5 px wide, accept IoU >= 0.5)
fraction of predicted strokes matched under the same rule

1 if n_pred == n_gt, every GT stroke is matched (IoU >= 0.5, one-to-one; splits/merges therefore fail) and matched predicted indices are in GT order; else 0. Name follows Wang et al. 2026; matching rule is ours
Kendall tau-b between GT index and predicted index over matched strokes (needs >= 2 matches)
over matched strokes whose GT start-end distance >= 2 px: fraction where predicted start is nearer GT start than GT end

uhwr_eval 0.2.0: per matched stroke (pred oriented to GT), total-variation distance between dwell-time distributions over 16 normalised arc-length bins, weighted by GT stroke duration; pen-up time ignored; NaN without timestamps
uhwr_eval 0.2.0: total-variation distance between GT and predicted shares of pen-down time over matched strokes (>= 2 matches); NaN without timestamps
uhwr_eval 0.3.0: orientation/order-invariant pen-up F1 on unordered stroke end-point pairs; cost = min over orientation of max end-point distance; Hungarian; TP if <= 3 px
uhwr_eval 0.3.0: timing_profile_tv with predicted segment midpoints binned by projected arc position on the matched GT stroke (not the prediction's own arc length); no orientation step
over matched strokes whose GT is curved/looped (|signed area| >= 4 px^2 and 4*pi*|A|/L^2 >= 0.1): fraction with sign(signed area) of prediction == GT (CW vs CCW)
direction_acc over matched GT body strokes (chord >= 2 px)
direction_acc over matched GT mark strokes (chord >= 2 px)
as body_direction_acc, chord >= 4 px
as mark_direction_acc, chord >= 4 px
matched GT marks / GT marks (same matcher as kendall_tau)
matched GT bodies / GT bodies
Kendall tau-b over matched GT marks (>= 2)
Kendall tau-b over matched GT bodies (>= 2)
GT marks written before own group's first body: share also predicted before it
GT marks written after own group's first body: share also predicted after it
matched GT marks whose predicted predecessor stroke (any kind) is the matched GT predecessor
matched GT marks whose last predicted BODY before it is the matched last GT body before it
